data.purge_details: Original C1 and legacy maturity before training end; inner calibration purged

mt5_fetch.not_applicable_reason: No broker fetch; sealed inputs only

model.label_definition: Frozen C1 target; C1 and legacy maturity purges
model.retention_status: stored_in_run_directory; representative only, not a production selection

predefined_search_space.causality: Pointwise transforms of certified causal input features; no shifts, labels, fitting, external data or new bars
predefined_search_space.htf_scope_note: Only Daily/H1/H4 trend remain. No HTF oscillator/volatility features exist to ablate. Do not invent absent groups.
predefined_search_space.weighting_rationale: v2 C_NONE is dominated by control; C_POS_110/120/130 fail WR and pooled economic guards. Retain BALANCED control and narrow +/-2.5% multiplier probes on the new feature baseline; no repeat of those settings.
selection_policy: candidate ID ascending only for exact ties
predefined_search_space.economic_preference: PF >= .90 and positive expectancy annotated; no subjective near-tie override of primary axes or fixed tie-break

event_hash_spec.serialization: JSON sort_keys=True separators=(comma,colon) ensure_ascii=True allow_nan=False UTF-8
event_hash_spec.payload: record_sha256=SHA256(canonical(raw record)) if record is not None; otherwise null; reference_pass hashes exact control row without status wrapper
event_hash_spec.timestamp: UTC aware ISO8601; nondecreasing; identical timestamps allowed; sequence strictly contiguous
event_hash_spec.research_freeze: research_complete terminates research chain; independent validator and archive are separate artifacts, never research events
